title: Hudson TUF-LITE II 7000H Series Hub | Cooling Tower Fans
description: Tuf Lite II 7000H series hub fan assemblies for cooling towers, a heavy duty hub variant for high load fans. Request pricing from ICST.

layout.title: Hudson TUF-LITE II 7000H Series Hub | Cooling Tower Fans

paragraphs: Adjustable Pitch Fan Assembly 34′ & 36′ Diameter. Blade Counts from 6 to 14.

Hudson Tuf-Lite II 7000H Series Hub (White, previously Blue) fan blades are made from fiberglass-reinforced vinyl-ester resin, which offers a high strength-to-weight ratio and ultraviolet and corrosion resistance. An elastomeric blade/holder joint cover prevents moisture from entering the blade.
